request: Build a Jac library that parses 5-field cron expressions (numbers, ranges, steps, lists and '*') and returns the next N run times after a given datetime. Invalid expressions raise an error naming the bad field. main.jac takes an expression, a start time and N on the command line and prints the times.
acceptance: '0 0 31 * *' from January 31 00:00 next fires March 31 00:00, skipping February.
'61 * * * *' is rejected with an error naming the minute field; a step of 0 is rejected.
constraints: Use Jac 0.36.1. This is a Jac library with a command-line entry in main.jac, not a web app.
No network, no external APIs; the library functions are pure and tested with `jac test`.

source.note: Requirements written in English from the project's feature description; no code or text copied. Only one feature slice is reproduced.

support_files.purpose: Configure Jac 0.36.1 with a [project] section (name, version) and entry-point main.jac.
